name: spot-btc/coinbase-premium
title: Coinbase premium — USD-venue vs Binance-USDT dislocation timer
description: The Coinbase BTC-USD price relative to Binance BTCUSDT, z-scored against its trailing 30 days of hourly bars, is traded as a hysteresis state machine (long once z > 0, flat once z < −1.5) and sized by a 50-day trend filter and an inverse-EWMA-vol scalar. The report's own conclusion is that the edge lives in the Binance-USDT quote leg, not in US institutional demand: a Coinbase-vs-Bitstamp (USD-vs-USD) premium has zero Sharpe.
live_notes: DEPLOYED AGAINST A FAILED ACCEPTANCE CRITERION. The research brief required Sharpe >= 2.0 and this strategy reaches 1.48 net; PR #6 was archived as a Failed result and is labelled `archived`, not `deployed`. It is live on an explicit operator decision to trade it at 1.48. The report puts P(true Sharpe > 2) at 5.6% and recommends discounting the 1.48 toward ~1.35 for best-of-310 selection bias — judge the live track against ~1.35, not against 1.48.
No cost gap: the research charges 10 bp/side and the runner's market orders pay the ~10 bp taker fee. The report's cost ladder is 0 bp 1.84 / 3 bp 1.73 / 5 bp 1.66 / 10 bp 1.48 / 20 bp 1.13.

Live turnover should run under the backtest's 88 side-trades/yr (44 round trips): the 5 USDT minimum notional swallows the hourly drift of the inverse-vol scalar, which the backtest charged in full. Turnover materially ABOVE 88/yr means the state machine is chattering and the premium feed should be checked first.

Second data feed. The premium needs Coinbase BTC-USD hourly candles from api.exchange.coinbase.com, refreshed by the runner into data/COINBASE_BTCUSD_1h.parquet. If Coinbase falls more than 3 hours behind Binance the runner raises rather than trading a frozen premium; a single missing bar only makes z NaN, and the hysteresis state then carries over, which is the spec's own rule.

Health check: the edge is +0.2 to +0.35 Sharpe over a plain SMA-50 × inverse-vol baseline that is itself ~1.25. If the rolling premium tercile spread (research: 6.9 bp/h, NW t 6.5 IS / 4.1 OOS) decays toward zero, what is left is the trend baseline and this sleeve stops being worth its correlation to spot-btc/weekday-trend (daily-return correlation 0.64, 0.70 OOS).
Overlaps two live spot-BTC sleeves. bult and weekday-trend are both long-BTC-in-uptrend; the venue pool is now fully subscribed at 10000/10000 USDT across four strategies.
